question: Does cap8 while any ready decode exists, then full remaining token budget, improve full-request tradeoffs relative to static8 with identical wrapper costs?
runtime: vLLM0.11.2 with unmodified pinned WiSP cap16 BF16; independent from vLLM0.26 absolute timings

resources.memory_binding: Unchanged: no explicit membind; taskset CPU0-7 plus external NUMA page observation

telemetry: Reuse affinity campaign: external 100ms NVML/CPU cgroup/NUMA observations; no new inline trace

policy.phase8: At pre-KV schedule entry: threshold8 while ANY current running request is ready for synchronous decode; otherwise threshold0 (native global token budget64 still applies).
policy.static8: Same wrapper, state checks and logging; threshold8 after action boundary in every call.
policy.enabled_boundary: Existing action key is created only after both original requests have exactly4output tokens.
policy.unsupported: Fail on async, speculative/prefix/preemption state, progress mismatch or any ready decode not scheduled exactly once.

preaction: Two original requests exactly4outputs; same scheduler/KV blocks, old tokens and complete pager/LRU state as calibration; old decode continues every step; no preemption
holdout_scope: Same three documents and previously explored action regime; controlled simple-baseline comparison, not independent document holdout.

first_action_payload.reason: Original snapshot counters do not isolate first-step demand loads; no payload prediction is claimed verified

total_payload: Sum final_worker pager_layers weight_copy_payload_bytes after measurement counter reset; complete episode includes preaction prefix; bytes are copied tensor bytes, not PCIe wire bytes
outcomes: actual selected thresholds and scheduled rows
interpretation: Retain all four arms and request tradeoffs. No invented SLO or method GO; no first-step copy claim with trace=false.
retention: New remote directory; all prerequisite campaigns must complete; GPU empty before directory creation and each cell; source hashes and preaction state checked per cell; first failure stops; no automatic retries.
transfer_contract: Upload code/config only. Reuse existing workload by remote-to-remote copy. Safe readback excludes workload.json and every result.json, prompt text, prompt token IDs and output token IDs.
